description: Pinned local language-model assets for IRL. These weights are NOT committed to Git (they are hundreds of MiB); scripts/setup.sh and scripts/setup.ps1 fetch them into .cache/models and verify the SHA-256 before the game uses them. No cloud service is contacted at gameplay time.

models.description: Compact instruction-tuned model used for NPC decisions. Chosen for CPU-only, low-memory hardware.
